Graphics driver 581.42 release notes

Fixed issues
- Vulkan applications could crash with VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST when a compute queue was
  submitted while the display went to sleep. [5123390]
- Corrupted shadows in some DirectX 12 titles after alt-tab. [5120114]
- The control panel reset the preferred refresh rate after reboot. [5118871]

Known issues
- HDR screenshots may look washed out in some capture tools.
